name: github-visual-universe
description: Open-source, read-only, personal GitHub intelligence and visualization platform.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @gvu/api && npm run build -w @gvu/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @gvu/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @gvu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run licenses:check
